Alisha & Aadil — a wedding invitation. 26 to 28 November 2026, Patna.

The Celebrations, a guide for our guests. Five moments over three days, 26 to 28 November 2026, Patna: I, Alisha’s Haldi, Thu 26 Nov, 5 PM, Lumea, ladies only, Dhoop, sunlight; II, Aadil’s Haldi & Mehndi, Fri 27 Nov, 4 PM, Lumea, Hina, henna at dusk; III, The Nikah, Sat 28 Nov, 4 PM, Kishan Palace, Qubool, the vow; IV, Reception Dinner, Sat 28 Nov, 8 PM, Kishan Palace, Ziyafat, the feast; V, The Rukhsati, Sat 28 Nov, after dinner, Dua, the blessing.

What each moment means. Haldi, the turmeric ceremony: Family and friends smooth turmeric paste onto the bride’s face and hands, a blessing for radiance before the wedding. Expect laughter, music and a great deal of yellow. Mehndi, the henna night: Aadil’s own turmeric blessing, then henna: fine patterns drawn on the hands while the evening fills with song and the beat of the dholak drum. Nikah, the marriage contract: The marriage itself. Before witnesses, bride and groom each say Qubool hai, “I accept”, sign the contract, and the gathering raises its hands in prayer. Reception, the wedding feast: Both families gather at long tables for a celebratory dinner, to greet the newly married couple and share in their joy. Do come and say hello. Rukhsati, the bride’s farewell: Alisha leaves her parents’ home to begin her new life, sent off with prayers and rose petals. A tender, often tearful moment; your blessings mean everything. Words you may hear: Mubarak, congratulations. Dua, a blessing. Shukriya, thank you.

Firoz Ahmad & Shaheen Ahmad invite you to the haldi of their daughter, Alisha. Thursday, 26 November 2026, five o’clock onwards. Ladies only. Lumea Cafe & Restaurant, Patna.
